findings.passage: “Our student IDs already meet the standards for voter identification. They’re issued by state institutions, include a photo, and show the student’s full name. This is not about voter security—it’s about further voter suppression.
findings.note: Statement released by her through the House caucus after the House passed SB 10 on April 1, 2025 (66-25), a bill that bars college students from using state-issued school IDs to vote. She says student IDs already meet the voter ID standard.
